purpose: Test whether causal reconstruction of forecast-time missing inputs preserves downstream SEP forecast utility better than simple causal recovery or abstention, without treating reconstructed values as observations.

missingness_scenarios.natural: preserve observed historical source missingness with masks
missingness_scenarios.synthetic_random: deterministic random held-out values within train-only score blocks
missingness_scenarios.synthetic_block: contiguous outage-style gaps of predeclared durations appropriate to each source cadence
missingness_scenarios.modality_dropout: remove complete forecast-time modalities to test fallback, degradation and abstention

physics_arm_requires: downstream performance is compared on identical masked issue identities
no material calibration degradation versus the best surviving nonphysics recovery arm
lower forecast degradation than the best surviving nonphysics recovery arm on predeclared missingness scenarios
survival_gate.failure_action: Do not include the physics reconstruction in the frozen final model; retain the negative result.

full_mhd_policy.role: candidate external physics reconstruction or feature provider only
full_mhd_policy.reason: A full MHD state is model output, not recovered sensor truth, and must demonstrate downstream value before inclusion.
minimum_requirements: runtime feasible for the declared research setting
state-to-feature mapping frozen before score evaluation
comparison against simpler physics and nonphysics recovery baselines

claim_boundary: No claim of accurate solar-flare simulation, operational certification, named-company superiority, economic savings, breakthrough, award outcome or final NEW-crossing improvement follows from this contract alone.
